LADANG SUNGAI SERAYA - FACT PACK (Far East Holdings Berhad). Deputy Chief Operation Officer / Plantation Controller En. Nazaruddin Bin Hasim; Assistant-In-Charge En. Mohamad Zubir Bin Abd Rahim (from 1 November 2025, succeeding En. Mohd Waliyudin, moved to Ladang Kampung Aur); supervisors En. Muhamad Hashimi Bin Romeli and En. Muhd Aliff Asyhraaf Bin Mazlan.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 2/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 4 August 2026, period reviewed January to June 2026, Planting Advisor Tn. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusof, based on the June 2026 progress report. (2) PA Report 1/2026, visit 15 January 2026, period January to December 2025. (3) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 18 March 2026, by En. Ghazali Bin Abdul Ghani (Junior Agronomist) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior Agronomist); previous visit 18 September 2025 (Agro 2/2025, which set the 2026 programme). Agro 1/2025 (14 April 2025) holds the 2025 programme.

AREA (PA 2/2026, June 2026). Total 912.53 ha; oil palm 870.90 ha all mature, average 123 SPH, DxP Felda: P02A 126.40 ha (132 SPH), P02E 113.00 (117), P07B 203.70 (123), P08F 139.20 (111), P09C 173.40 (130), P10D 115.20 (126). Buildings 4.80 ha, vacant 36.80 ha (to be confirmed). Planted 2002-2010. Flat to undulating, about 5% hilly; low-lying areas flood. PARAS GIS palm counting done in 2025: stand fell 7% from 115,553 to 107,312 palms (133 to 123 SPH), mainly Ganoderma. Replanting: P02E in 2028 agreed (PA 2/2026); Agro 1/2026 tentative P02E 2029, P02A 2030; P02E fertiliser to be withdrawn by 2028.

LABOUR (PA 2/2026, June 2026). 73 workers vs requirement 65 (surplus 8; 1 per 12 ha): FFB harvesters 39 (req 37; 1 per 22 ha), mandore 1 (3), loaders and drivers 7 (6), weeding 4 (6), manuring 7 (8), general workers 15 (5). 7 checkroll, 66 contract. In 6 months 12 recruited, 6 repatriated, 3 unfit, 2 transferred out, 7 absconded. Contractors: Nusantara (harvesting, all fields, 60 workers), MH Keratong (FFB transport P02A, P09C), Adienal (FFB transport P07B, P08F). Keep a harvester buffer for the H2 peak. PA 1/2026 (Dec 2025): 77 workers incl. 42 harvesters.

CROP (PA 2/2026 Table 16, Jan-Jun 2026). FFB 8,315.96 t vs budget 9,000 t; same period 2025 9,060.54 t; annual budget 20,000 t; 2025 actual 22,078.60 t. Yield 9.55 t/ha vs budget 10.33 and 10.40 last year (8% below both); annual budget 22.96 t/ha; 2025 25.35. CPO 1,653.12 t, OER 19.88% (budget 19.11); kernel 402.76 t, KER 4.84%; CPO 1.90 t/ha. Bunch numbers promising for H2 2026. Block tonnes Jan-Jun 2026: P02A 1,465.02 t, P02E 1,053.24, P07B 1,913.48, P08F 1,232.16, P09C 1,589.18, P10D 1,062.88. Agro 1/2026 Jan-Feb 2026 yield 3.56 t/ha vs 2.25 (+58%): P02A 4.34, P02E 3.11, P07B 3.64, P08F 3.22, P09C 3.61, P10D 3.34. Monthly 2026: Jan 1,699.86 t, Feb 1,400.48 t.
2025 (PA 1/2026): 22,078.60 t, 25.40 t/ha (25.35 in text and Agro), 10% above the 20,000 t budget, in line with 2024 (22,255.41 t, 25.6). 132 SPH, 9.12 bunches per palm, ABW 21.13 kg, 23.80 rounds. Block 2025 (t, t/ha): P02A 3,100.60, 24.53; P02E 2,516.28, 22.27; P07B 4,982.24, 24.46; P08F 3,341.41, 24.00; P09C 5,148.36, 29.69; P10D 2,989.82, 25.95. 2024 t/ha: 25.26, 23.03, 26.52, 22.77, 27.50, 27.13. Estate history t/ha: 2018 21.51, 2019 22.97, 2020 20.87, 2021 20.39, 2022 24.92, 2023 18.72, 2024 25.55, 2025 25.35. Tonnes: 2020 18,175.36; 2021 17,759.46; 2022 21,701.31; 2023 16,299.45; 2024 22,255.42; 2025 22,077.61 (Agro monthly) / 22,078.60 (PA). 2025 monthly: Jan 1,021.90, Feb 938.24, Mar 1,320.50, Apr 1,620.37, May 2,016.12, Jun 2,142.42, Jul 2,275.90, Aug 2,110.30, Sep 2,237.60, Oct 2,484.52, Nov 2,066.04, Dec 1,843.70. Early 2025 crop dip blamed on seasonal factors.

HARVESTING (PA 2/2026). Interval below 15 days in all fields, 12.35 rounds in 6 months; no unharvested ripe bunches, no unripe bunches. Productivity 2.17 t/manday (3,834 mandays), earnings RM78.39 average: P02A 2.40 t, RM39.50/t, RM94.80/day; P02E 2.06, RM40.50, RM83.43; P07B 2.11, RM34.50, RM72.80; P08F 2.25, RM77.63; P09C 2.18, RM75.21; P10D 2.01, RM69.35. Mechanised in-field collection: Timac 618.70 ha (5 units, 26 harvesters) 11.34 t/machine-day, 2.31 t/harvester-day (text: 4 units, 2.83); Badang in P08F 11.39 and 2.93 t; crawler in P02E 9.94 and 2.46 t. Agro 1/2026: 2025 intervals 12-19 days; over-ripe about 1% in D1, C3, B4, F3; no backlog.

COST (PA 2/2026 Table 18, Jan-Jun 2026, RM per t FFB). General charges 83.98 vs 95.94; upkeep and cultivation 109.74 vs 122.27; harvesting and collection 76.54 vs 86.22 (harvesting 48.86, internal transport 27.68, no external transport); total ex-estate 270.26 vs 304.43 (11% below; annual budget 273.98). General charges RM698,370.46 = RM801.90/ha vs RM991.46 (19% under); overspent: Socso management RM2.39/ha (+12%, HRDF levy), water labour RM18.37 (+8%, industrial rate), recruitment RM74.43 (+182%, calling visas to be recovered), workmen insurance RM0.28 (+69%), stationery RM8.03 (+7%), assessment taxes RM5.97 (+100%, paid early), MSPO (+12%, audit 29 July 2026). Upkeep RM912,580 = RM1,047.86/ha vs RM1,263.55: weeding 110.37 (125.00), manuring 811.76 (883.62), pest and disease 29.11 (63.13), census 5.04 (7.08), drains 2.77 (36.51), roads 25.95 (73.41, grading paid after July), boundaries 1.97 (2.00), pruning 60.88 (72.79). Capex: playground RM28,000 (budget RM25,000) done; new office pending KMTT approval; staff furniture and manuring trailer pending. 2025 (PA 1/2026): ex-estate RM224.21/t vs budget 259.64 (GC 69.89, U&C 78.87, H&C 75.45); with processing, transport, cess and windfall tax RM326.16/t.

MANURING. PA 2/2026 Table 10: Jan Mix B 148.20 t; Feb NK1 75.80 t and Mix B 120.00 t; Mar RP 118.20 t; Apr Mix A 124.70 t completed; May Mix B 69.30 t delivered not applied; Jun Mix B 65.40 t not delivered and NK1 42.30 t delivered; total 763.90 t required, 698.50 delivered, 586.90 applied. Delay from late delivery and sub-soil work in low-lying and terrace areas; June Mix B in progress during visit. EFB 225 mt applied to P08F1 at 30 mt/ha; complete 1,000 mt allocation. Agro 1/2026: 19% by Feb; NK1 delayed; RP in B3 applied evenly, 30 bags/worker; 2025 programme 1,123.40 t fully applied. 2026 revised programme (Agro 1/2026 App 1, kg/palm): P02A NK1 2.50 Feb, 2.50 Jun, 1.50 Sep; P02E NK1 2.50 Feb, 2.00 Aug; P07B B1/B2 Mix B 9.00 sub-soil Feb + RP 1.50 Mar; B3/B4 Mix B 2.25 Jan, RP 1.50 Mar, Mix A 2.25 Apr, Mix B 1.50 Jul, Mix A 1.50 Oct; P08F same as B3/B4; P09C C1/C2 Mix B 2.25 Jan, RP 1.50 Mar, Mix A 2.25 Apr, Mix B 1.50 Jun, Mix A 1.50 Sep; C3/C4 Mix B 2.00 Jan, RP 1.50 Mar, Mix B 7.00 sub-soil May; P10D Mix B 2.50 Jan, RP 1.50 Mar, Mix A 2.25 Apr, Mix B 1.50 Jun, Mix A 1.50 Sep. The second-half rates were cut from the original Agro 2/2025 programme (2.25-2.50 kg). Mix A = 45% AS, 40% MOP, 15% kieserite; Mix B adds 1% borate (14% kieserite); NK1 = 50% AS, 50% MOP.

WEEDING (PA 2/2026). Circle spraying 870.90 of 997.30 ha (87%); selective 1,220.50 of 1,429.20 ha (85%); slightly behind. Circle 6.00 ha/manday, RM84/day; selective 5.00 ha/manday, RM75/day; both mist blower; use CDA for circles to stop over-spraying. Sodium chlorate spot spraying controlled Stenochlaena and Tetracera. Missed Clidemia patches in P10D. Agro: 2025 weeding complete except one circle round in P07B; first 2026 inter-row round done in P02A and P07B by Feb; ferns in P07B circles treated with glyphosate + metsulfuron-methyl.

PESTS AND DISEASES. Rat baiting 669.50 ha to June 2026 (P07B 241.70, P08F 139.20, P09C 173.40, P10D 115.20) with Storm (flocoumafen); continue above 10% fresh damage. Agro rat census Feb 2026: P07B 15%, P08F 7%, P09C 14%, P10D 8%; 2025 peaks 21-29%. Barn owls: 73 boxes, 1 per 12 ha, 71 occupied, 97% (Agro Mar 2026: 100%). No bagworm since last year. Ganoderma: mounding stopped in P02A, P02E (palms over 20 years); continue in younger fields (P09C in 2026); deboling in P08F and P10D (D1 inspected, in order). Beneficial plants Turnera and Antigonon; add Cassia cobanensis.

OTHER FIELD WORK. Drains: about 50 ha of low-lying P02A, P07B, P09C flooded 10 days in January 2026; avoid spraying drain edges; Guatemala grass at culverts good practice; minimal drain work in 2026. Roads: grading from May 2026 (2,965 chains in 2025); mark silt pits and scupper drains; frond tipping along roads; laterite soggy and inclined stretches; new path in hilly P02E. Boundaries with UMAC and FELCRA well maintained; patrol highway; no FFB left overnight. Pruning: progressive, good frond retention; stack fronds on contour in P02E; do not over-prune Ganoderma palms; Agro: first round completed Feb 2026, no over-pruning. Camber bunds in P09C2 and P09C4 improve yield.

LEAF NUTRIENTS (Agro 2/2025, March 2025 sampling). N marginally low in most sub-blocks, deficient in B2 (2.46%); K marginally low in B1 and B2; Mg below range in D1; P, Ca, B adequate. Agro 1/2026: mild K and Mg deficiency on laterite or sandy soils; sampling in 2026 for the 2027 programme.

RAINFALL (mm, days). 2021 1,850 (111); 2022 1,808 (152); 2023 2,036 (127); 2024 1,411 (113); 2025 2,138 (123); Jan-Jun 2026 775 mm over 49 days.

CONCLUSIONS. PA 2/2026: performance satisfactory, 9.55 t/ha and RM270.26/t to June; improvements in ground cover, EFB and canopy; rats and Ganoderma need more attention; prepare for H2 peak crop. Agro 1/2026: agronomic condition acceptable; rat infestation needs close monitoring and control.
